full_judgment: 6. Further, the reschedulement of interest in accordance with the new reschedulement, will start from January, 2006 and continue up to December, 2009. The total principal amount on 01-01-2000 was Taka 1,06,13,21,677.00 and interest as on 31-12-2005 will be Taka 46,28,57,143.00 By letter No. BRPD (P) 651/9(4)Kha/99-1575 dated 17-11-1999 the Bangladesh Bank has given 'No objection' to the proposed reschedulement (Annexure-A) which, according to the petitioner, has been done in violation of circular 07 of 1999.
